name: body_length
comment: Outer length, as built in fusion/heartsync_assembly.py

name: body_width
comment: Outer width

name: body_thickness
comment: Shell thickness: tray 29.8 + lid 3.0. Stack with the back ring 1.5 proud: 34.3

name: body_thickness_max
comment: HARD LIMIT. The stack-up must never exceed this

name: wall_thickness
comment: Tray wall and front wall

name: corner_radius
comment: Outer corner radius under the fabric wrap

name: fabric_allowance
comment: Fabric thickness. Fabric only on the tray TOP edge; the back is bare PETG

name: panel_width
comment: 64 px at 2 mm pitch

name: panel_height
comment: 32 px at 2 mm pitch

name: panel_depth
comment: Panel plus connectors. Measure the real panel

name: panel_pitch
comment: P2

name: battery_length
comment: LiPol LP1160100: 100 +-1 (PCM folded inside the length). Max used for fit

name: battery_width
comment: LP1160100: 60 +-0.5. Max used for fit

name: battery_thickness
comment: LP1160100: 11 +-0.3. Max used, so the 1.2 swell gap sits above the thickest cell

name: battery_swell_gap
comment: Free space over the cell face. At least 1 mm (1.2 used)

name: pcb_thickness
comment: Standard FR4

name: gasket_width
comment: Gasket channel in the lid rim under the tray wall (IP54), continuous

name: gasket_compression
comment: Tune to the gasket material

name: dock_magnet_count
comment: Four magnets in the dock

name: dock_magnet_diameter
comment: 6 x 2 NdFeB disc (cad/models/magnet_6x2)

name: dock_magnet_thickness
comment: 6 x 2 NdFeB disc

name: pogo_pin_count
comment: 4 pads centred on the bottom edge

name: fit_clearance
comment: General clearance between printed parts. Tune per printer

name: lid_thickness
comment: Back cover. 3.0 keeps 1.2 between the back-ring channel (1.0) and the gasket channel (0.8)

name: corner_radius_inner
comment: Inside corner radius (outer 6 minus wall)

name: cell_pad
comment: Foam pad under the cell (cell holder, no heat path to the lid)

name: cell_insulator_top
comment: Insulator on the cell top face, below the swell gap

name: lip_width
comment: Lid tongue that stands inside the tray wall

name: lip_height
comment: Lid tongue height. Interrupted behind the speakers

name: lip_clearance
comment: Tongue to tray inner face. Tune after the PLA test print

name: gasket_depth
comment: Gasket channel depth (lid 2.2 thick under it)

name: gasket_cord
comment: Silicone cord diameter for the channel

name: insert_hole_d
comment: M2 heat-set insert hole. General M2 guidance 3.0-3.2; confirm with the insert maker

name: insert_hole_depth
comment: Insert length 3 plus 1

name: insert_boss_d
comment: Tray corner boss (insert wall 1.2)

name: screw_clearance_d
comment: M2 close-fit hole in the lid (keeps 1.2 to the gasket channel)

name: screw_pad_h
comment: Lid pad under each screw

name: fit_button
comment: Button cap to hole, per side

name: fit_usb_c
comment: USB-C receptacle to opening, per side

name: fit_pogo
comment: Pogo pad to hole, per side

name: fit_magnet
comment: Magnet to pocket, per side and depth

name: min_wall
comment: Minimum printed wall (3 perimeters at 0.4)

name: ring_od
comment: Front ring groove = Qi2 marking, centred on the coil

name: ring_width
comment: Front ring groove width

name: ring_depth
comment: Front ring groove depth (ring_inlay fills it)

name: honeycomb_hex
comment: Hex hole across flats

name: honeycomb_pitch
comment: Hex pitch (web 0.8)

name: honeycomb_wall
comment: End wall thinned to this in front of the speaker

name: membrane_thickness
comment: ePTFE acoustic membrane over the whole honeycomb

name: speaker_gasket
comment: Foam gasket, speaker face to membrane

name: speaker_length
comment: CES-571423-28PMB enclosed speaker (along Y)

name: speaker_height
comment: CES-571423-28PMB (along Z)

name: speaker_depth
comment: CES-571423-28PMB (along X)

comment: Pogo target pad on the bottom edge

name: gnss_patch_t
comment: GNSS patch thickness

name: screw_x
comment: Lid screw X (+-)

name: screw_head_h
comment: M2 low-head screw head height

comment: Ring outer edge, in from the back outline

name: back_ring_proud
comment: Ring height above the back face

name: back_ring_pocket_h
comment: Pocket depth (head 1.3 + 0.2)
